reforms.description: The Technology Reinvestment Project allocated $202 million towards flat-panel display research and development, aiming to enhance domestic manufacturing capacity in this technology area.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing domestic manufacturing capacity in technology is expected to raise productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been actively allocated and utilized as intended.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the reform is not structural or system-wide.
reforms.source_quote: The Technology Reinvestment Project gave some $202 million toward flat-panel display research and development in October 1994 in exchange for promises by the recipients to build domestic manufacturing capacity for the existing technology.

reforms.description: The 'Goals 2000' initiative aims to improve the quality of the education system by establishing voluntary national standards for initial education and vocational skills.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Improving education quality is expected to enhance the skills of the workforce, thereby supporting innovation and productivity.
reforms.status_evidence: The initiative has been established and is actively influencing educational standards.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative represents a significant overhaul of educational standards.
reforms.source_quote: Goals 2000 seeks to improve the quality of the education system in a variety of ways, including the creation of 'voluntary' national standards for initial education and for vocational skills.

reforms.description: The 'School-to-Work Opportunities Act' provides seed money to states and localities to develop improved systems for preparing students for college and careers.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Developing systems for better career preparation is expected to enhance workforce readiness and innovation capacity.
reforms.status_evidence: The act has been enacted and is actively providing funding for workforce development.
reforms.importance_rationale: This act represents a significant investment in workforce development.
reforms.source_quote: The 'School-to-Work Opportunities Act' provides 'seed money' to states and localities to plan and develop improved systems for preparing students for college and careers.
